about: A Consumer's placement of several ranges (ADR-0050 item 4, the note of 2026-11-12, issue #561): the ranges as handed, in their order, each made in its own turn, with the Focus where the Consumer names it. The Script Core's alone: the C# Selection places one range and is not widened.

cases.name: ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): several ranges are placed in the order handed, in place of the selection there was, with the Focus on the cell named
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): the order handed is kept, not sorted: Enter walks the ranges as they were handed
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): ranges that overlap are placed as handed, neither merged nor refused, and their cells count twice as Excel's status bar counts them (ADR-0014)
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12), ADR-0055: a Focus that several ranges hold belongs to the one handed last of them
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12), ADR-0052: each range is made in its own turn, so the range made last is the one handed last, and a take-out puts the Focus there
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): one range in a list is the one-range placement
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): no range, a range reaching outside the grid, a range of no cell, or a Focus in none of the ranges is refused rather than clamped, and nothing changes
ADR-0050 item 4 (2026-11-12): a grid with no cells has nothing to place on
